scope: The 3,349 dockets in data/filings.json, searched for Wikipedia articles only.
method: Each docket's case name was searched through the Wikipedia API. An article is linked only when its subject is this lawsuit (not a party, statute or topic) and it names this docket number or describes the case in this court; a Supreme Court article counts when it is the same lawsuit on review.
